arxiv-2005-02320.title: Model studies of fluctuations in the background for jets in heavy ion collisions
arxiv-2005-02320.creator: Charles Hughes, Antonio Carlos Oliveira da Silva, Christine Nattrass
arxiv-2005-02320.description: Abstract Jets produced in high energy heavy ion collisions are quenched by the quark gluon plasma. Measurements of these jets are influenced by the methods used to suppress and subtract the large, fluctuating background and the assumptions inherent in these methods. We compare the measurements of the background in Pb+Pb collisions at s N ​ N \sqrt{s_{NN}} = 2.

arxiv-2110-06129.title: Backward Touchard congruence
arxiv-2110-06129.creator: Grzegorz Serafin
arxiv-2110-06129.description: Abstract The celebrated Touchard congruence states that B n + p ≡ B n + B n + 1 B_{n+p}\equiv B_{n}+B_{n+1} modulo p p , where p p is a prime number and B n B_{n} denotes the Bell number.

arxiv-2111-05107.title: Rovibronic spectroscopy of PN from first principles †
arxiv-2111-05107.creator: Mikhail Semenov, Nayla El-Kork, Sergei N. Yurchenko, Jonathan Tennyson
arxiv-2111-05107.description: Abstract Abstract We report an ab initio study on the rovibronic spectroscopy of the closed-shell diatomic molecule phosphorous mononitride, PN. The study considers the nine lowest electronic states, X\,{}^{1}\Sigma^{+} , A\,{}^{1}\Pi , C\,{}^{1}\Sigma^{-} , D\,{}^{1}\Delta , E\,{}^{1}\Sigma^{-} , a\,{}^{3}\Sigma^{+} , b\,{}^{3}\Pi , d\,{}^{3}\Delta and e\,{}^{3}\Sigma^{-} using high level electronic structure theory and accurate nuclear motion calculations.

arxiv-2202-09768.title: Tropical curves in abelian surfaces II: enumeration of curves in linear systems
arxiv-2202-09768.creator: Thomas Blomme
arxiv-2202-09768.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Thomas Blomme. In this paper, second installment in a series of three, we give a correspondence theorem to relate the count of genus g g curves in a fixed linear system in an abelian surface to a tropical count. To do this, we relate the linear system defined by a complex curve to certain integrals of 1 1 -forms over cycles in the curve.

arxiv-2310-18300.title: Quantum simulation of the tricritical Ising model in tunable Josephson junction ladders
arxiv-2310-18300.creator: Lorenzo Maffi, Niklas Tausendpfund, Matteo Rizzi, Michele Burrello
arxiv-2310-18300.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lorenzo Maffi, Niklas Tausendpfund, Matteo Rizzi, Michele Burrello. Modern hybrid superconductor-semiconductor Josephson junction arrays are a promising platform for analog quantum simulations. Their controllable and non-sinusoidal energy/phase relation opens the path to implement nontrivial interactions and study the emergence of exotic quantum phase transitions. Here, we propose the analysis of an array of hybrid Josephson junctions defining a 2-leg ladder geometry for the quantum simulation of the tricritical Ising phase transition.

arxiv-2502-18505.title: Comprehensive Analysis of Transparency and Accessibility of ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and other SoTA Large Language Models
arxiv-2502-18505.creator: Ranjan Sapkota, Shaina Raza, Manoj Karkee
arxiv-2502-18505.description: Abstract Despite increasing discussions on open-source Artificial Intelligence (AI), existing research lacks a discussion on the transparency and accessibility of state-of-the-art (SoTA) Large Language Models (LLMs). The Open Source Initiative (OSI) has recently released its first formal definition of open-source software.

arxiv-2504-16435.title: Toward a Principled Workflow for Prevalence Mapping Using Household Survey Data
arxiv-2504-16435.creator: Qianyu Dong, Yunhan Wu, Zehang Richard Li, Jon Wakefield
arxiv-2504-16435.description: Abstract Understanding the prevalence of key demographic and health indicators in small geographic areas and domains is of global interest, especially in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where vital registration data is sparse and household surveys are the primary source of information.

arxiv-2604-25395.title: Excess logarithmic residues for foliations by curves and applications

pmc-11046588.creator: Hamza Hussain
pmc-11046588.description: interventions strategies currently reported and to evaluate their effects on muscle mass, muscle strength, and physical function outcomes in sarcopenic participants. Methods Web of Science, ClinicalTrials.gov and Scopus were systematically searched for exercise, nutritional, pharmacological and other randomised controlled trial interventions in participants diagnosed with sarcopenia and ≥50 years of age.

pmc-11634778.title: PDGFRA is a conserved HAND2 effector during early cardiac development
pmc-11634778.creator: Yanli Xu, Rupal Gehlot, Samuel J. Capon, Marga Albu, Jonas Gretz, Joshua Bloomekatz, Kenny Mattonet, Dubravka Vucicevic, Sweta Talyan, Khrievono Kikhi, Stefan Günther, Mario Looso, Beth A. Firulli, Miloslav Sanda, Anthony B. Firulli, Scott Allen Lacadie, Deborah Yelon, Didier Y. R. Stainier
pmc-11634778.description: The basic helix–loop–helix transcription factor HAND2 has multiple roles during vertebrate organogenesis, including cardiogenesis. However, much remains to be uncovered about its mechanism of action. Here, we show the generation of several hand2 mutant alleles in zebrafish and demonstrate that dimerization-deficient mutants display the null phenotype but DNA-binding-deficient mutants do not.

pmc-12506056.title: Association between blood pressure and metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease among adults without hypertension: a cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2017–2018
pmc-12506056.creator: Shujing Wu, Ning Chen, Mengzhang Wu, Yongquan Wang, Zhaoming Huang, Jie Zhang, Jianan Li, Demin Xu, Lihua Guan, Junbo Ge
pmc-12506056.description: AbstractObjectiveHigh blood pressure (BP) is one of the optional components of metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD). However, whether subclinical elevations in BP are related to MAFLD even in the absence of hypertension remains unclear. We investigated the association between BP and MAFLD among adults without hypertension.

pmc-12591078.title: Laser, vacuum and gas reaction chamber for operando measurements at NSLS-II’s 28-ID-2
pmc-12591078.creator: Lauren Y. Moghimi, Patrik K. Johansson, Subhechchha Paul, Yifan Wang, Sara Irvine, Remington Graham, Deja Dominguez, Zane Taylor, Angel A. Martinez, John T. Markert, John Trunk, Hui Zhong, Jianming Bai, Sanjit Ghose, Leora Dresselhaus-Marais
pmc-12591078.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). A laser reaction chamber has been developed for in situ/operando X-ray diffraction measurements on the NSLS-II 28-ID-2 beamline, allowing for rapid sample heating under various gas and vacuum conditions. This capability has enabled the tracking of chemical reaction kinetics in polycrystalline iron oxide and a reversible phase transformation in WTe2 with 1 s time resolution, expanding the opportunities for dynamic studies in both bulk and single-crystal materials. Introduction

Time-resolved measurements give insight into the mechanisms underlying materials synthesis and processing.

pmc-12684051.title: Epidemiology of Norovirus Outbreaks in Kindergartens, Primary Schools, and Junior High Schools in Xi’an, China, From October 2020 to February 2023
pmc-12684051.creator: Hui Zhang, Xin-qian Gu, Lei-le Zhang, Chun-juan Wang, Zheng Wei
pmc-12684051.description: BackgroundNorovirus outbreaks frequently occur in semi-closed environments like schools and kindergartens. Current strategies are inadequate. This study aimed to examine several important characteristics of norovirus outbreaks in kindergartens, primary schools, and junior high schools reported to the Xi’an Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) between October 2020 and February 2023.Material/MethodsData were obtained from the Xi’an CDC.

pmc-12730020.title: Structural and Histomorphological Evaluation of the Stifle Joint Capsule in Canine Congenital Patellar Luxation and Cranial Cruciate Ligament Rupture
pmc-12730020.creator: Mario Candela Andrade, Petra Peer, Pavel Slunsky, Matias Aguilera-Rojas, Johanna Plendl, Leo Brunnberg
pmc-12730020.description: Simple SummaryPatellar luxation (PL) and cranial cruciate ligament rupture (CCLR) are common causes of lameness in dogs, often linked to inherited joint weakness. This study examined the microscopic structure of the stifle joint capsule in affected dogs to understand how these conditions alter joint tissues.

pmc-12749033.title: A study on factors influencing music enthusiast’s behavioral intention to use generative AI for music composition based on an expanded technology acceptance model
pmc-12749033.creator: Yongxin Zhou, Yuhui Wang, Jiayu Su
pmc-12749033.description: This study aims to understand the intentions of music enthusiasts in using generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) for music composition and to elucidate the factors influencing those intentions. A covariance-based structural equation modeling approach is applied to construct a technology acceptance model (TAM). A total of 429 valid questionnaire responses were analyzed to explore music enthusiasts’ acceptance mechanisms regarding GenAI tools.

pmc-13050040.title: The bile acid-CoA ligase, FATP5, is necessary for the synthesis of N-acyl taurines in the liver
pmc-13050040.creator: Katharina B Kuentzel, Samuel AJ Trammell, Anna S Hassing, Benjamin P Garfinkel, Ivan Bradić, Kathleen Tchoukoua, Matthew P Gillum, Martin R Larsen, Trisha J Grevengoed
pmc-13050040.description: N-acyl taurines (NAT) are endogenous, bioactive conjugates of fatty acids and taurine with roles in carbohydrate and lipid metabolism. In the liver, NATs are synthesized by bile acid-CoA:amino acid N-acyltransferase (BAAT), which also conjugates bile acids to taurine or glycine, suggesting an overlapping hepatic synthesis pathway.

pmc-13066926.title: Mycotoxins and plant diseases in a changing climate: from pathogen ecology to smart surveillance and mitigation strategies
pmc-13066926.creator: Ilham Dehbi, Abdelaaziz Farhaoui, Khadija Benamar, Fatima Ezzahrae Smouni, Hakima Achetoui, Mohammed Kouighat, Mouna Janati, Essaid Ait Barka, Hamid Mazouz, Rachid Lahlali
pmc-13066926.description: Mycotoxins, secondary metabolites produced by pathogenic fungi such as Fusarium, Aspergillus, Penicillium, and Alternaria pose a significant threat to global food safety and agricultural productivity. These toxins often arise concurrently with plant diseases, particularly under favorable environmental conditions that enhance fungal infection and colonization.

pmc-13082757.title: A large-scale concordance study of toxicity findings across preclinical species and humans for small molecules and biologics
pmc-13082757.creator: Xin Liu, Fan Fan
pmc-13082757.description: Translating preclinical safety findings into reliable insights for human risk assessment remains a fundamental challenge in drug development. Prior preclinical-clinical concordance studies have been constrained by limited drug coverage, reliance on identical-term matching for adverse events (AEs), and limited consideration of species, modality, exposure, and biological or mechanistic context.

pmc-13113921.title: An Electrospun Fibrous Eye Mask with Antibacterial and Antioxidant Functions
pmc-13113921.creator: Xinhang Duan, Leting Wang, Chuxuan Cheng, Yili Zhang, Bingyue Guo, Hantong Wang, Jinghui Shi, Wenliang Song
pmc-13113921.description: Ocular infections and inflammation represent a clear risk to eye health, but standard eye masks often lack the necessary therapeutic features. Moreover, most existing studies employ a blended electrospinning approach, which leads to an inhomogeneous spatial distribution of the therapeutic agents. However, using the coaxial technique can address these limitations.

pmc-13152056.title: The theory of hypertensive heart disease and heart failure: revisiting the evidence and pathophysiology
pmc-13152056.creator: Maria Giulia Bellicini
pmc-13152056.description: Arterial hypertension is a major epidemiological risk factor for left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH) and heart failure (HF). Within this framework, the theory of hypertensive heart disease (HHD) has historically been proposed as the conceptual substrate for HF with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF).

pmc-13187098.title: Graphitic carbon nitride for biomedical applications: challenges and future opportunities in dentistry
pmc-13187098.creator: Manal Matoug-Elwerfelli, Swapna Thomas, Hadeel Kheraldine, Sara Adan Mahmoud, Asad Dabbour Asad, Abdalrahman Alkahlout, Ahmed Abdou, Hani Nazzal, Monty Duggal, Aboubakr M. Abdullah Ali
pmc-13187098.description: Graphitic carbon nitride (g-C3N4) is an emerging nanomaterial with unique features such as photocatalyst, biocompatibility, and tunable surface chemistry, placing g-C₃N₄ as a versatile platform for innovative biomedical applications. This review explores the properties, synthesis, biomedical applications, challenges, and future perspectives of g-C₃N₄.

pmc-13242759.title: DIF: Concepts, Measurement, and Impact in Patient-Focused Drug Development and Regulatory Decision-Making
pmc-13242759.creator: Kai Cao, Wei Liu, Lei Yang, Meimei Luo, Yan Hou
pmc-13242759.description: Differential Item Functioning (DIF) is critical for Patient-Focused Drug Development (PFDD), particularly in validating Patient-Reported Outcome (PRO) tools. This study links DIF analysis to regulatory decision-making. DIF directly impacts the reliability of drug approval evidence, trial result interpretation, and subgroup consistency evaluation.

pmc-13298158.title: A Rare Coexistence of Biliary Atresia and Alagille Syndrome in a Neonate: Clinical Implications of Dual Etiology in Neonatal Cholestasis
pmc-13298158.creator: Wan-Ning Wu, Hung-Chang Lee, Hsiang-Yu Lin, Nien-Lu Wang, Wai-Tao Chan, Shu-Chao Weng, Chuen-Bin Jiang
pmc-13298158.description: Background and Clinical Significance: Biliary atresia (BA) and Alagille syndrome (ALGS) represent distinct anatomic and genetic causes of neonatal cholestasis. Their overlapping clinical, biochemical, and early histological features present a formidable diagnostic challenge in early infancy, and their simultaneous coexistence is exceedingly rare.

pmc-13305263.title: Depth of the Dorsalis Pedis Artery Distal to the First and Second Tarsometatarsal Joints: A Cadaveric Anatomical Study
pmc-13305263.creator: Taro Fujimaki, Hiroaki Kurokawa, Yuki Ueno, Takahide Sasaki, Kouhei Mitsui, Akira Taniguchi, Hirotaka Haro, Pasuk Mahakkanukrauh, Yasuhito Tanaka
pmc-13305263.description: Background:Surgical procedures involving the region between the first and second metatarsals distal to the tarsometatarsal (TMT) joints are common. However, detailed quantitative information regarding the depth of this arterial axis, encompassing the dorsalis pedis artery proximal to the branching point and the first dorsal metatarsal artery distally, remains limited.

pmc-13357282.title: Serum vitamin D levels and prostate cancer: an umbrella review and pooled analysis of observational meta-analyses
pmc-13357282.creator: Li Wei, Lina Fan, Huifen Wang
pmc-13357282.description: BackgroundThis umbrella review examines the controversial link between serum vitamin D levels and prostate cancer (PC) risk by systematically re-analyzing existing meta-analyses. It aims to synthesize the available evidence while acknowledging the inherent limitations of umbrella reviews and observational data.

pmc-13400250.title: Beyond cognition in post-stroke cognitive impairment: neuropsychiatric symptoms and stroke-specific cognitive screening
pmc-13400250.creator: Polona Rus Prelog, Matija Zupan, Senta Frol
pmc-13400250.description: Highlights•Depression and apathy can confound post-stroke cognitive test performance.•Validated post-stroke depression and apathy scales should be used routinely.•Relying only on MoCA may miss focal and domain-specific post-stroke deficits.•Stroke-specific screens (e.g. OCS, ACE-III, CCAS-S) complement global measures.•Tailored screening plus neuropsychiatric assessment improves PSCI evaluation. Pantoni et al.

pmc-13427903.title: Does cortisol mediate the association between school bullying and weight status in preadolescents?
pmc-13427903.creator: Izaro Babarro, Ainara Andiarena, Jesus Ibarluzea, Maialen Otamendi, Mònica Guxens, Martine Vrijheid, Nerea Lertxundi
pmc-13427903.description: Childhood obesity and bullying are interconnected public health issues that negatively influence both, physical and mental health. Stress could be an explanatory mechanism mediating the relationship between bullying victimization and obesity. Thus, this study aims to investigate whether hair cortisol levels mediate the association between bullying and weight status.

uslaw-usc-t12-s5234.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 52 (Emergency Economic Stabilization); Subchapter I (Troubled Assets Relief Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any Federal financial regulatory agency shall cooperate with the Federal Bureau of Investigation and other law enforcement agencies investigating fraud, misrepresentation, and malfeasance with respect to development, advertising, and sale of financial products.
